local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local mainFrame = LMG2L["Frame_2"]

local dragging = false
local dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function updateInput(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = mainFrame.Position

        local connection
        connection = input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
        end)
    end
end)

mainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input == dragInput) then
        updateInput(input)
    end
end)

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local decal = LMG2L["DecalImage"]
local screenGui = LMG2L["ScreenGui_1"]

local baseDecalSize = 180
local minSize = 100

local function updateDecalSize()
    local screenWidth = screenGui.AbsoluteSize.X
    local scaleFactor = math.clamp(screenWidth / 1920, 0.4, 1)
    local decalSize = math.max(baseDecalSize * scaleFactor, minSize)
    
    decal.Size = UDim2.new(0, decalSize, 0, decalSize)
end

updateDecalSize()

screenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(updateDecalSize)

local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

LMG2L["TextButton_c"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    updateDecalSize()
    
    local size = decal.AbsoluteSize.X
    
    decal.Position = UDim2.new(0, -size, 0.5, -size / 2)
    decal.Visible = true
    decal.ImageTransparency = 0

    local tween1 = TweenService:Create(decal, tweenInfo, {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -size / 2, 0.5, -size / 2)})
    tween1:Play()

    tween1.Completed:Connect(function()
        local finalPos = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, -20 - size)
        local tween2 = TweenService:Create(decal, tweenInfo, {Position = finalPos})
        tween2:Play()
    end)
end)

LMG2L["TextButton_d"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

LMG2L["TextButton_e"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

        if obj:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            obj:FireServer(text)
        end
    end
end)
